decisions: D-052 and D-053 (the user: "4 seeds + pilot check", "210 s + level window"), D-054 (the orchestrator, T-048's T048-12 and T048-14)
status: post hoc to docs/L7V2_DESIGN.md and to ml/p1_prereg.json, before any capture and any P1 data, and before the code it judges. It adds to ml/p1_prereg.json, which stands

timeline.replaces: section 14's 30 + 120 + 30 s, on P1's every phase
timeline.arrivals: ml/l7v2_prereg.json arrivals, unchanged, on the longer slot: benign over [0, 180] s, attack over [30, 180] s, one lifetime capped at the attack's end. flash_gap_s now fits, so it is kept: the crowd's minute starts over [90, 120] s

harm_windows.primary: the verdict's harm contrasts read Q from the attack's start + 90 s to the attack's end, the never-sent guard on that window (ml/l7v2_verdict_prereg_v3.json level_window)
harm_windows.secondary: Q over the whole attack window, reported beside it per arm
harm_windows.admission: harm admission, the placebo and the ladder's knees read the whole attack window, as registered

reported_per_class.time_to_decision: per arm and family, on the U replays: from an attack entity's first request to the arm's decision, over the caught entities, mean and median

attack_cost_left.replay: per arm, on the U replays: the share of the attack's cost, the record's class cost of each attack request, not removed by the arm's decisions; a request is removed when it starts at or after max(decision, the entity's first request + key_age_gate_s) + reload_s, the worst case of the enforcing path. A share of 1 means that nothing was removed
attack_cost_left.live: per arm with M runs of the class: the class cost of the attack's 2xx requests in its M runs over the same in the U runs of the same blocks

validation.replaces: ml/p3_prereg.json seeds.p3_val [2001, 2002], for every arm's selection
validation.plan_checks: the plan's own checks on the new seeds, the frozen age limits among them, unchanged: a seed they refuse is reported, never redrawn

point_check.when: after the ladder, before the campaign's first run
point_check.traffic: the pilot's benign traffic: one valid control C per pilot seed, of the phases health and ladder, at the frozen factor, replayed through each arm at its frozen operating point
point_check.ladder_seeds: the ladder's pairs of runs cycle through the eight pilot seeds, so that each seed has a control
point_check.reported_only: every other arm of the selections
point_check.budget: benign units flagged in the replay, pooled over the seeds, at most floor(budget x the benign units pooled); budget from ml/l7v2_model_prereg.json selection
point_check.over_budget: an arm in `stops` over the budget stops the campaign until a dated decision, named on the command line and recorded with every block
point_check.incomplete: a pilot seed without a valid control leaves the check incomplete, and a campaign refuses it
point_check.no_retune: the check reads the frozen points and changes nothing: nothing is re-tuned silently

run_validity.recorded: per M run, in run.json and the run's record: the shadow's last evicted and late counts (the l7_shadow events) and every daemon_error event
run_validity.invalid_when: evicted > 0 on an arm's own rule path, or a restart of the shadow thread (daemon_error at thread:l7_shadow) in the attack window

bans_by_engine.rule: the bans of each run by engine, in run.json and the run's record
